product_metadata.title: VARWANEO Ice Cube Trays, Easy-Release Silicone and Flexible 14-Ice Trays with Removable box, LFGB Certified and BPA Free,Easy to fetch ice， Stackable and Dishwasher Safe
features: FOOD-GRADE SAFETY: Zedco ice cube trays are made of food-grade silicone and PP material which 100% BPA free and . Perfect for home, bars, parties, restaurants, etc.

MULTIPURPOSE ICE MAKER: The ice trays perfect for cooling whisky, cocktail, wine, coffee, tea, lemonade, Coca-Cola, juice and more beverages; making baby food or delicious snacks like fruit popsicles, ice cream and more.

EASY ICE REMOVAL：There is an ice outlet on the lid. Ice cubes can fall into any place you want it to fall through the ice outlet. Avoid hand contact throughout the process, one step in place, more hygieni

WITH REMOVABLE LID: With PP lid, the smart design of the silicone ice cube tray will minimize spills and prevent ice cubes from absorbing freezer odors, it helps trays stack neatly in the freezer without sticking and taking up too much space.

DISHWASHER SAFE: Easy to use, just fill it with water (fruits, soda or anything to meet your taste), put the lid on and then put it in the freezer. Easy to clean, simply rinse with water or directly put into the dishwasher.
description: Great Performance:It stands -40 to 230℉ and is applicable to refrigerator and microwave
Our ice trays are made of food grade silicone and polypropylene, bpa-free and dishwasher safe.
The bottom of the tray is very smooth and well formed, allowing the ice to be released easily.
The ice tray has a large lid that allows you to release the ice in the box, making sure it doesn't get loose.
And absorb the smells from the fridge.
Each ice tray can make up to 14 large blocks of ice. Enjoy it!
Please do NOT overflow the cube slot with water.
Please do NOT clean this product with metal brush, please clean it with soft cloth.
Please do NOT take out ice cubes by twisting the trays, or it may break,
Just push out from the silicone bottom. When you take the ice cube trays out of freezer, the ice is usually tightly attached to the ice molds;
please wait for a while, and then it will be much easier to push out the cubes.
Keep the trays away from fire sources.
